title: Chapter 88
text: Manifest Dismantling I have thrown away my lantern, and I can see the dark. –WENDELL BERRY, A NATIVE HILL 1 If you become interested in the health of the place where you are, whether that’s cultural or biological or both, I have a warning: you will see more destruction than progress.
